provenance.geometry: Transcribed from the repository's committed ICLR 2026 template measurements; matches web/presets/papers.json (iclr2026). Browser placement is approximate.

provenance.diagnostics: Existing project heuristics, not validated aesthetic thresholds or conference acceptance criteria.
provenance.font_family: The inherited DejaVu Sans is a portable rendering fallback, not a prescribed figure font. No serif/sans-serif policy is imposed.

placement.note: Canvas includes labels and any outside legend; height is width × aspect ratio. Text-wrap checks do not apply to full-width/non-wrapped placement.
